description: Synthetic Swiss test network for the network scheduler and the live map (decision 0025 §8). Weather, profiles and specific values are sourced; positions, building sizes, server counts, tanks, non-Basel prices and Type 1 volumes are synthetic and marked per field. Generated by scripts/build_network_dataset.py (seed 20251121). Not a market study.

serverCount.source: prototypes/year-explorer/index.html: four-server comparison scenario, not a case requirement

tankCapacityKwh.source: docs/case/challenge.md: approximate usable storage, no losses

electricityPriceChfPerKwh.source: data/raw/elcom/iwb-basel-h4-2026.json: Basel total 33.25 Rp./kWh divided by 100

shareOfHeatLedServerHours.note: Decision 0025 §6: central value of the 10/30/50 % sweep; no sourced Type 1 demand (decision 0020).

serverHoursPerJob.note: Job = 1,000 LLM documents (synthetic batch size) x 0.92 Wh per document measured in T-33 (docs/jobs/llm-summary.md), at 1 kW per server.

placement.source: Synthetic test scenario: customers require computing in Switzerland (decision 0020 value proposition); not a real contract.
